title: Fighter jet scrambled and possibly fired on the 1952 DC lights

tellings.quote: of discussion that actually there were some I think it was an f105 U fighter jet that was actually scrambled to intercept those lights those luminous objects and there's even one report reported account where perhaps uh they were asked to fire upon and may have actually hit one of them

plain: In 1952, when glowing lights were reported over Washington DC, an F-105 fighter jet was supposedly sent up to intercept them, and by one account its pilots may have been told to fire and may even have hit one. A former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo repeats this from discussions he heard about the event, not as something he saw himself. If true, it would mean the military fired on unknown objects over the capital.
